statement: These pinned Linux HID and SDL PS4 HID consumer files do not enumerate, configure, or validate a USB Audio Class interface for a physical DS4. They cannot establish physical UAC presence, channel count, formats, mic routing or whether functional 2-output/1-input sidecar emulation matches a real DS4.

applicability.scope: Searched DS4 common output parser/send path and SDL PS4 effect output path only; ALSA USB descriptor/physical captures not yet inspected.
